description:
The second half of P1, and the part the 2026-08-04 finite-strain decision added.

code_aster's small-strain constitutive kernels are reused at finite strain by
wrapping them: GDEF_LOG pre-processes the deformation into a logarithmic
(Hencky) strain, calls the small-strain law, and post-processes the resulting
stress back to the true (Cauchy) measure with the corresponding tangent
transformation. Without that wrapper the ported laws can only be driven at small
strain, which the maintainer explicitly decided against.

The pieces already exist:
- hencky_strain and DeformationGradient landed in P0
  (rheology/aster/kinematics.rs), including the near-identity series branch.
- The scalar local solvers landed in the first half of P1
  (rheology/aster/integration.rs).

What remains is the wrapper itself: the stress and tangent pull-back, and the
boundary with OFFBEAT's MechanicsSolver, which is small-strain and therefore
differs in kinematics. That boundary must be explicit in the API rather than
implied -- see the P0 bead.

Upstream reference: the GDEF_LOG handling in bibfor/comport_prep/ and the
deformation dispatch in bibfor/lc/. Read those before designing the API.

Acceptance: a law driven through the wrapper reproduces the small-strain result
in the infinitesimal limit (the same convergence check P0 used for the strain
measure), and the stress transformation is verified objective under a superposed
rigid rotation.

---

title: code_aster P1b: GDEF_LOG finite-strain wrapper around the small-strain kernels

description: Robust mesh boolean (union/difference/intersect) for MeshOp::Boolean. Blender uses the Manifold library. Most relevant operator for producing outram-mc-libs CSG-adjacent geometry.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: PARTIAL landed (2026-07-17): src/boolean.rs implements convex-mesh Intersect via half-space (Sutherland-Hodgman) clipping + cap reconstruction -> closed convex manifold. Verified: cube[-1,1]^3 ∩ [0,2]^3 = box[0,1]^3 chi2 (exact to 1e-9); 45deg-rotated ∩ axis cube = octagonal prism V16/E24/F10/chi2. 6 tests. STILL OPEN: Union + Difference return Unsupported; general non-convex Intersect unsupported (convexity check is a heuristic, not a proof). Robust route (exact predicates + arrangement + inside/outside classification, Manifold-style) remains.

title: outram-blender: boolean/CSG mesh operator

description: GH #37 §B. Merge at center / cursor / first / last / collapse; Auto-Merge within a threshold during editing; Merge-by-Distance modes beyond the landed weld/remove-doubles.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: src/merge.rs (new, ~230 LOC + 5 tests): merge_vertices(verts, MergeTarget{Center|Point(cursor)|First|Last}), merge_edges(edges) (collapse each to midpoint, union-find chains), merge_by_distance(verts, threshold) (subset weld = Auto-Merge's per-edit op). All via a vertex remap + degenerate-face drop + unreferenced-vertex compaction. Verified: 2 corners -> -1 vert, at-point placement, grid edge collapse, subset weld drops a duplicate, far-apart verts untouched. clippy clean.

title: outram-blender: merge modes + auto-merge (center/cursor/first/last/collapse, threshold)
